tagline_ro: Religia LUI Isus, nu religia DESPRE Isus
tagline_en: The religion OF Jesus, not the religion ABOUT Jesus

thesis.ro: Adventismul Zilei a Șaptea contemporan se confruntă cu o întrebare străveche: cultivăm religia LUI Isus (credință experiențială, ascultare a voii Tatălui) sau religia DESPRE Isus (sistem doctrinar despre persoana Lui)?
thesis.en: Contemporary Seventh-day Adventism faces an ancient question: do we cultivate the religion OF Jesus (experiential faith, doing the Father's will) or the religion ABOUT Jesus (a doctrinal system concerning his person)?

owner.name: Mircea Matthews
owner.notes: This is Mircea's personal production company and channel. Primary subject: The Urantia Book. May include edited work from other creators (e.g. Dr. Geaboc) but is not their channel — it is Mircea's own creative and theological work.

youtube_channel_setup_note: Log into YouTube as jabbokriverproductions@gmail.com and create the channel. Handle: @JabbokRiverProductions

geaboc.relationship: Mircea manages this channel on behalf of Dr. Geaboc. Raw video delivered weekly (20GB+), edited in Final Cut Pro, transcribed, diacritics corrected, branded with JabbokRiver Productions intro/outro, then uploaded here. Separate from the JabbokRiver Productions channel.
